findings.why: The documents contain no controlled approval record for Fonderia Pellice (SUP-H) on HB-620 for Beinasco (PLT-BEI) and Nordhavn (CUST-NOR). The meeting only says the move depends on an audit and PPAP, and nothing shows they were completed. The absence of a record doesn't mean the source is not approved, so a person must confirm whether the audit and PPAP are done and a release exists. I took the customer to be CUST-NOR from the 8D, which mentions the Nordhavn line.
